title: Towards Generalist Graph-Level Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.07706v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph-level anomaly detection (GLAD) aims to identify graphs that deviate significantly from the majority. While recent advances have achieved competitive performance, existing approaches mainly follow a dataset-specific paradigm, requiring substantial in-domain data and training cost when applied to new application scenarios. This limits their scalability and practicality in real-world applications where labeled data is scarce and diverse domains are continuously emerging. In this paper, we investigate the problem of generalist GLAD, which seeks to learn a single unified model capable of detecting anomalous graphs across multiple domains with minimal supervision on the target data. This problem introduces key challenges, including learning transferable patterns from heterogeneous graph datasets and effective adaptation under limited supervision. translated_title: 迈向通用图级别异常检测
translated_abstract: 图级别异常检测（GLAD）旨在识别与大多数图存在显著偏差的图。尽管近期的研究已取得了具有竞争力的性能，但现有方法主要遵循针对特定数据集的范式，在应用于新的应用场景时需要大量的领域内数据和训练成本。这限制了它们在现实应用中的可扩展性和实用性，因为现实中标注数据稀缺，且多样化的领域不断涌现。在本文中，我们研究了通用GLAD问题，该问题旨在学习一个单一的统一模型，能够在对目标数据进行最少监督的情况下检测跨多个领域的异常图。这一问题带来了关键挑战，包括从异构图数据集中学习可迁移的模式，以及在有限监督下进行有效的适应。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了GenGLAD，一种通用的GLAD方法，它利用……
tldr: 提出GenGLAD，一种通用图级别异常检测方法，通过学习单一统一模型，在极少目标域监督下实现跨多个领域的异常图检测。
en_tdlr: Proposes GenGLAD, a generalist graph-level anomaly detection approach that learns a single unified model capable of detecting anomalous graphs across multiple domains with minimal supervision on target data.
